earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/alef/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds METADATA_comments.txt, no source.
disclose: The released fonts are hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the releases', its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.

The release's `head` table states fontDirectionHint 0; the build states 2, the only value the OpenType specification allows new fonts (the field is deprecated and no renderer reads it). A `.glyphs` source cannot state the field, so the difference is kept and disclosed.
